data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old Italian word 'rugiero', meaning 'little warrior'. The name Ruggiero has its roots in the Latin word 'ruggere', which means 'to shout' or 'to roar'. In Italian folklore, Ruggiero is a famous knight and sorcerer, known for his bravery and cunning. The name Ruggiero carries the meaning “Little warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ruggiero usually hope their child will grow to embody little warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
